notes: Type notes: a page beside the paper that you type on like any document, with headings, lists, bold, italic, underline and highlight. Beside a video or with the clock running, each new paragraph gets its time, and a paragraph can be marked as a strength, a next step or a question.
Each assignment says whether typed notes go back to the student as a page of the returned paper, and in what text size: Compact, Standard or Large. Help has a new answer.
